dct_description_sm: Schedule “A” indicates the General Land Use Designations committing the use of land. These land uses include areas designated as Residential, Retail, Office, Business Corridor, Industrial, Institutional, Open Space. The map also shows areas, such as the Provincial Greenbelt Area/Protected Countryside, Central Area, North West Brampton Urban Development Area, Special Land Use Policy Area, Special Study Area, Corridor Protection Area, Parkway Belt West, the L.B.P.I.A. Operating Area, Deferral Area and the Provincial Highways.
dct_title_s: Official Plan Schedule A General Land Use Designations
